title: Why I Left The Church: The Truth Revealed! #shorts

top_liked.author: @outermarker5801
top_liked.text: I left because after decades of experience there is absolutely no difference between people of faith and people without. Good, bad, indifferent or monsters, people just are who they are. There are no 'peculiar people' demonstrating a righteous 'god'.

I walked away because I never found god in any church, all I found were people that I found unpleasant and judgmental.
I finally found a better place to be which helped me much more.
